title: Explore Others' Paths: How to Listen When Others Blow Up or Clam Up
heading: Chapter 08
chapterLocalFacts: AMPP means Ask, Mirror, Paraphrase, and Prime when the other person is holding back or escalating.
ABC means Agree, Build, and Compare once the other person's path is on the table.
Mirroring names an emotion that seems visible but unspoken.
Priming is risky and only works when offered humbly as a guess, not as imposed meaning.
bridgeForward: Chapter 9 turns dialogue into action by clarifying how decisions are made and who does what by when.
